title: Armour of the Sporekeeper
summary: +1 spell save DC and 1 extra Necrotic damage when dealing Necrotic damage. With Symbiotic Entity active, access Bibberbang, Timmask, and Haste Spores.

fields.Effect: +1 spell save DC and 1 extra Necrotic damage when you deal Necrotic damage. Multiple Necrotic sources in the same damage instance do not multiply the extra point.
fields.Base value: 1050 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Spore Sacks: The granted spore actions require active Symbiotic Entity and each recharges on Long Rest. Each cloud has a radius of about 7 ft.
fields.Bibberbang Spores: Action, range 60 ft. Listed as a ranged spell attack for 2d4 + 1 Poison. Creates Noxious Fumes for 3 turns.
fields.Timmask Spores: Action, range 60 ft. Listed as a ranged spell attack for 2d4 + 1 Poison against creatures in the area. Creates a cloud for 2 turns and can apply Befuddled for 1 turn, causing creatures to wander without control.
fields.Haste Spores: Bonus Action, range 60 ft. Creates a cloud for 3 turns that hastens creatures entering it for 1 turn. The condition grants +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity saves, 30 ft extra movement and an additional action. It causes no Lethargic when it ends.
fields.Honour Mode: The extra Haste Spores action cannot use Extra Attack. Slowed can end the effect and prevent it from being reapplied.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
